defect.where: vendor/sphincsplus/ref/merkle.c:29 `info.wots_steps = steps;`, reached through the textual #include at crypto/bpq/bpq_slh.c:60
defect.cause: merkle.c:25 declares `unsigned steps[SPX_WOTS_LEN]` (the type chain_lengths takes, wots.h:23); wotsx1.h:15 declares `uint32_t *wots_steps`. arm-none-eabi-gcc defines __UINT32_TYPE__ as `long unsigned int` (x86-64 and i386: `unsigned int`), so the two pointer types are distinct there and -Werror makes the assignment an error. Both are 32 bits everywhere; it is a distinct-types diagnostic, not a size mismatch. The only instance in the translation unit.
